svg.aria-label: From primitives, a running ledger of tools built where none fit. Instead of a vendor score: in-house IP intelligence. Instead of a paid API: a geocoding engine over open data. Instead of an SDK: Apple App Attest verification in Rust from raw bytes. Instead of plaintext search: encrypted blind indexes. Stamp reads: built, not bought.
